explanation.uz: who/which/that ergash gapning to'ldiruvchisi bo'lsa tushiriladi: 'the film that I saw' → 'the film I saw'. Ega bo'lsa tushirib bo'lmaydi.

grammar.positive_example: The report I sent yesterday has been approved.
grammar.negative_example: The man works here is my uncle.

l1_notes.uz: Ega va to'ldiruvchi farqini ko'rmaslik — tushirib bo'lmaydigan joyda tushirishga olib keladi.

grammar.label: question tags and echo questions in conversation
grammar.form: …, wasn't it? / Did you? / Have you really?
grammar.meaning: showing interest and keeping a conversation going

explanation.en: An echo question repeats the auxiliary to show interest: 'I went to Rome.' — 'Did you?' It is not a real question; it invites more.
explanation.uz: Aks-savol yordamchi fe'lni takrorlab qiziqish bildiradi: 'I went to Rome.' — 'Did you?' Bu haqiqiy savol emas, davom etishga taklif.

l1_notes.uz: Yordamchi fe'l gapdagisiga mos kelishi shart; o'zbekchada bunday javob shakli yo'q.

phonology.label: Fall-rise for reservation and polite disagreement
Rise-fall in choices, lists and alternatives
Polite intonation in requests — wide pitch range

exponents.text: If I have understood you both, the disagreement is about timing.
You both want the same result — the question is how.
Can I put it another way?

functions.label: Small talk in a professional setting

exponents.text: Have you been to this office before?
Anyway, shall we make a start?

functions.label: Managing a conversation — interrupting and coming back

exponents.text: Sorry, could I just add something?
As I was saying, the deadline is Friday.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: The report I sent last week has been accepted.

body.speaker: Bobur
body.text: Has it really? That was quick.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: It was. The man I spoke to on Monday called me himself.

body.speaker: Bobur
body.text: Did he? He never calls anybody.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: He does now. The money we asked for is there.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Most of it. The part they cut was the part I expected.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: I did. The first thing I wrote was the part I could lose.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Mr Karimov taught me that. He has been doing it for thirty years.

body.speaker: Bobur
body.text: Has he? Then I should ask him about my own report.
